messages:
Priya: Heads-up PolarisRx wants traffic pinned to eu-central-1 for a UK pilot. They need proxy allowlisting and a short demo throughput bump next month. Renewal flagged ":renew:" they're price-sensitive and asked for a cost + throughput walkthrough.
noah_net: Ok. ask them for ASN/CIDRs and an ops contact for LOA. Prefer proxy peering?
Priya: Confirmed proxy peering. CIDRs they gave: 51.15.200.0/27, 51.15.201.128/28, and NAT 198.51.100.5. Ops contact: netops@polarisrx.co.uk. Demo window: 2026-09-14T09:00Z -> 2026-09-17T17:00Z (UK mornings).
Sam_se: Baseline for them is 60 req/min. Recommend temp bump to 320 req/min and dedicated route to keep KV/prefix cache affinity. Suggest pre-warm 12h before demo.
Gina_csm: I'll schedule the renewal touch and prepare a concise cost/throughput deck + ROI one-pager. Also will run post-demo survey (latency, p50/p95, errors).
Hector_ops: Ephemeral allowlist ok. Propose TTL=9 days, auto-revoke 2026-09-26T09:00Z UTC. We will notify CS 24h before revoke. Noah, can infra apply route pin + ACLs?
noah_net: Yep. need LOA attached to ticket and written confirmation of the window. I'll queue change once received. change_id=chg_pr_20260914_01.
Priya: LOA uploaded to ticket #CS-55921 and customer confirmed window in writing.
Sam_se: Pasting single-source route config for infra ops so we don't diverge:
```
route: /v1/generate/polarisrx
region_pin: eu-central-1
route_mode: dedicated
rate_limit: 320/min
kv_cache_warm: true
allowlist_cidrs:
  - 51.15.200.0/27
  - 51.15.201.128/28
  - 198.51.100.5/32
ephemeral_ttl_days: 9
auto_revoke_at: 2026-09-26T09:00Z
enablement_flag: "needs_cost_walkthrough"
notes: "Demo 2026-09-14 -> 2026-09-17; pre-warm 12h; CS to run post-demo survey and schedule renewal review"
```
Hector_ops: Queued network change: change_id=chg_pr_20260914_01, status=queued; exec_window=2026-09-14T00:00Z->2026-09-14T04:00Z UTC. Approving TTL & auto-revoke. Will set auto-notify 24h before revoke.
ticket-bot: network-change: queued change for customer=polarisrx, change_id=chg_pr_20260914_01, status=queued
Gina_csm: thanks team 44aa. I'll follow up with post-demo survey template and add the enablement invite to PolarisRx calendar.
noah_net: will apply ACLs once change window opens. tagging @Hector_ops for revoke ownership.
Hector_ops: owning revoke. Will confirm when revoked and attach post-demo metrics to the ticket.
